exempt.RemoteAudit.DifftestMain: the remote-audit-difftest executable's entry point, one line; it serves RemoteAudit.Difftest.table, audited under RemoteAudit.Difftest, through the difftest server's line protocol: a test and not a proof
exempt.RemoteAudit.VerdictMain: the remote-audit-verdict executable's entry point, one line; it serves RemoteAudit.PostSeed.fns, audited under RemoteAudit, through the difftest server's line protocol, which audit.post_seed and the difftest both call: a server and not a proof

RemoteAudit.why: the verifier is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and hm96, and core's randomness; no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (RemoteAudit.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
